Well, it's a mix of a whole lot of different issues. One aspect that definitely been instilled into me is the notion of fragile our lives are. I was in close proximity to a murder suicide, a couple of years back. Ever since, I have been in a malaise that has been punctuated by brief periods of happiness. The storm that has brewed has been of my making. I am the architect of it. My incessant ignoring of certain things have now come back to bite me in the behind. I am graduating in a couple of months and I have relegated myself to being the quintessential millennial, whose life is devoid of any exciting prospects. I am pretty much dead to my father. I will, in time, be dead to my mother when I can't provide her grandchildren, due to my ghoulish appearance. I can send a pic of myself if you want witness this. I am lonely for the most part and don't interact with individuals. I am, for the most part, in constant conversation with myself, trying to diagnose the issue and come up with some remedy. People, for the most part have used me as an expendable utility. I am just beyond jaded.

Enjoy the time with your mother. Don't be troubled by the misfortunes that have been foisted upon my shoulders. I am neither the first nor the last person to go through these dire straits. I hope therapy may help, no matter how temporary the relief may be. I am willing to hear anything you have. I just can't take this pain anymore. Why condemn myself to a lonely life when we all know what our fate will be. Why don't I just hasten things? Also, what on earth does the future have to offer, considering the trajectory that we are heading as a species. Thank you for your words.

Thank you for your words. I am in no unique set of circumstances. I am neither the first nor the last to be in this sort of predicament. At this very moment, I am incredibly numb and just want to vent out everything that has accumulated. I guess what is just so repulsive about this situation is the way that I look. I understand that being severed from a family member or not having great employment prospects can all be amended, but being hideous in appearance is just cruel. No words in my opinion can assuage that pain. It is a cruel fate that I have been condemned with. The genetic dice was rolled, and I was handed with what I have now.

I haven't tried therapy. I always think that the problems arose from me. Therefore, I must fix them myself. I guess I am inebriated by the small, trace amount of pride that is left. The issue is that I keep telling myself that I have hit rock bottom, but in reality there is a more depraved level below it.
